answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a copper stake that is slashed on fraud, with reputation growing slowly like a trellis: new agents may only take small jobs, and trust is earned through verified, paid work over time, like an orchard maturing season by season. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund each stake and grind each reputation from zero, so the cost of flooding the market far exceeds any reward from a single fake agent.
